acceptanceCriteria: The fixtures either pin package versions that verify cleanly, or the TRE qualification matrix records the provenance limit with the content hashes.
No witness claims full signature verification for these packages.
body: Found by the V1-0593 native runner lane (beamfall/corvint#1001, head 20b4c6e0e, 2026-10-17, macOS 26 arm64). Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/native-2026-10-17/cases/. Restoring the VSTest/MTP qualification fixtures reports NU3028/NU3037 (expired countersignature) for microsoft.bcl.asyncinterfaces 6.0.0, microsoft.win32.registry 5.0.0, system.diagnostics.diagnosticsource 5.0.0, system.security.accesscontrol 5.0.0, system.security.principal.windows 5.0.0. Witnesses were produced, but the toolchain-provenance claim for these packages is weaker. Question: pin newer versions without the expired countersignature, or record a provenance limit (repository signature + SHA-512 content hash) in the TRE qualification matrix?
title: NuGet signature verification fails on five transitive packages with expired countersignatures (NU3028/NU3037)
